references.text: Prohibition against sexual relations with a woman and her mother, including the mother-in-law relationship described in Deuteronomy
The penalty for taking both a woman and her mother as wives, related to the prohibition against sexual relations with a mother-in-law
Ezekiel mentions shameful acts with a mother-in-law as one of the sins committed in Israel
Part of the broader context of curses over various sins, where the people affirm with 'Amen'
